difficulty:0.en: The server room under Block Nine had no power. I moved through the dark by touch alone, every step a *difficulty* I had not planned for. Grey Crow had warned me the backup grid was gone. Without light, without maps, I was already lost — and someone else was already inside.
difficulty:0.cnHint: 调查员在断电的机房里独自摸黑前行，遭遇重重____。
difficulty:0.hook: A second pair of footsteps matched mine, perfectly.
difficulty:0.line: 'Every *difficulty* you meet in here was designed by Zero.'

full:0.en: The emergency cabinet was supposed to hold six signal boosters. I pulled it open and found it *full* — every slot packed, every wire live. Grey Crow had restocked it without telling me. That meant he had been here recently. That also meant he knew what was coming tonight.
full:0.cnHint: 调查员打开应急柜，发现里面装得____，暗示引路人早有准备。
full:0.hook: One booster carried a label written in my own handwriting.
full:0.line: 'The cabinet is *full* — Grey Crow was here before us.'

range:0.en: Ali spread the sensor data across the wall screen. The signal covered a *range* of six city blocks, tight and deliberate. 'Someone is broadcasting on a closed channel,' she said. I traced the edge of the cone with my finger and stopped. The origin point was this building.
range:0.cnHint: 阿栗展示的信号____精确指向调查员所在的建筑。
range:0.hook: The broadcast had started exactly when we entered.
range:0.line: 'That *range* is too neat — Zero chose this spot on purpose.'

region:0.en: The blackout did not hit the whole city. It was locked to one *region*: the old port district, grid seven. Everything else glowed outside the window. Inside our zone, even the emergency lights had died. Someone had cut power with surgical precision, and we were the target.
region:0.cnHint: 停电只发生在特定____内，调查员意识到这是针对他们的精准打击。
region:0.hook: My comm unit showed one bar — then none.
region:0.line: 'This *region* going dark is not an accident — run the logs.'

material:0.en: Grey Crow dropped a data chip on the table. 'The walls in this sub-level are lined with signal-blocking *material*,' he said quietly. 'Nothing gets in. Nothing gets out.' I looked at the grey panels around us and understood: whoever locked this room had planned to keep someone inside it.
material:0.cnHint: 引路人告诉调查员，房间墙壁使用了特殊____，信号完全无法穿透。
material:0.hook: The door behind Grey Crow gave a soft, final click.
material:0.line: 'That *material* in the walls means Zero can't hear us — or find us.'

pressure:0.en: The ventilation shaft was the only way forward. I squeezed in and crawled, the metal walls closing around me with steady *pressure* on both shoulders. Forty seconds in, the shaft narrowed. I could not go back. Ahead, a faint red light blinked in the dark like a slow heartbeat.
pressure:0.cnHint: 调查员爬进通风管道，四周的____越来越大，进退两难。
pressure:0.hook: The red light blinked twice — then went still.
pressure:0.line: 'Feel that *pressure*? The shaft is collapsing — keep moving.'

thus:0.en: All three relay nodes had been switched off from inside the room. No one had broken in; the locks were clean. The shutdown was done by someone with full access, *thus* it had to be a person on our own list. Ali and I looked at each other across the dark table and said nothing.
thus:0.cnHint: 三个节点均从内部关闭，调查员____将嫌疑人锁定在内部名单中。
thus:0.hook: Ali slowly slid her access card off the table.
thus:0.line: 'The locks are clean, *thus* our leak is someone we trust.'

tool:0.en: Zero had left one thing behind: a small folding blade, the kind used to strip wire. It was not a weapon. It was a *tool*, and it was placed dead-centre on the floor as a message. Grey Crow crouched over it without touching it. 'He wants us to know,' he said, 'that he was working.'
tool:0.cnHint: 零点留下一件____，引路人认为这是一条刻意传递的信息。
tool:0.hook: The blade was engraved with tomorrow's date.
tool:0.line: 'This *tool* is a message — Zero finished something here tonight.'

consume:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Control Tower Nine. I watched the backup grid *consume* the last reserve power, bar by bar, until only red remained. Ali pressed her back against the cold rack. Outside, the city went dark. Someone had planned this.
consume:0.cnHint: 备用电网正在____最后的储备电力，城市陷入黑暗。
consume:0.hook: The door handle turned — from the outside.
consume:0.line: 'It will *consume* everything we stored in under a minute,' Ali said.

desire:0.en: Grey Crow slid a cracked data chip across the table. 'Take it or leave it.' I felt a sharp *desire* to leave, to walk out into the rain and forget Harbor City. But the chip held the only map to Zero's base. My hand moved before my head did.
desire:0.cnHint: 我内心有一种强烈的____，想要逃离这个城市。
desire:0.hook: The chip was already warm — someone else had held it.
desire:0.line: 'I know the *desire* to run. Don't,' Grey Crow said.

meal:0.en: Ali set a bowl of hot rice on the floor between us. In a city where food lines ran three blocks, one warm *meal* meant someone owed you a favour. Grey Crow said nothing. He just ate. I wondered what he had traded to get it.
meal:0.cnHint: 在这座城市里，一顿温热的____意味着有人欠你一个人情。
meal:0.hook: Grey Crow's bowl was still half full when he stood up.
meal:0.line: 'Eat. This *meal* may be the last quiet moment we get,' Ali said.

vegetable:0.en: The only colour in the safe house was a single wilted *vegetable* — a pale green stalk in a cracked cup on the windowsill. Ali watered it every morning. Zero's signal had been traced to this block. She kept watering it anyway.
vegetable:0.cnHint: 安全屋里唯一有颜色的东西是窗台上一棵枯萎的____。
vegetable:0.hook: Tonight the cup was knocked over, soil still wet.
vegetable:0.line: 'I brought one *vegetable* — small comfort, I know,' Ali said.

adopt:0.en: Grey Crow spread the blueprints flat. 'We cannot fight straight. We must *adopt* Zero's own method — false signals, ghost routes.' I had spent a year chasing Zero by the rules. The rules had failed. I picked up the marker and drew the first fake path.
adopt:0.cnHint: 我们决定____对手的战术，用假信号对付他。
adopt:0.hook: The marker ran dry on the last line of the route.
adopt:0.line: '*Adopt* his tricks, or we lose before dawn,' Grey Crow said.

miss:0.en: Static filled my earpiece. Then a voice — clear, cold. 'Hello, *miss*.' Zero had never spoken to me directly before. The word landed like a blade. He knew my face. He knew I was here. Ali froze beside me, her hand on the switch.
miss:0.cnHint: 零点第一次直接对我说话，用____称呼我，令我震惊。
miss:0.hook: He said my real name next.
miss:0.line: 'You almost had me, *miss*. Almost,' Zero said.

yourself:0.en: The mirror in the back room was the old kind — glass, not screen. Grey Crow stopped me in the doorway. 'Before we go in, ask *yourself* one question: what will you do if the signal is a trap?' I looked at my reflection. I had no answer.
yourself:0.cnHint: 进门前，灰鸦让我问____一个关键问题。
yourself:0.hook: Inside, the signal was already broadcasting my name.
yourself:0.line: 'Ask *yourself* if you are ready for what comes next,' Grey Crow said.

century:0.en: The building was a relic — poured concrete and iron bolts, built before the last *century* turned. Grey Crow said Zero always hid in old shells because new scanners skipped them. I ran my fingers along the wall. The stone was cold and indifferent.
century:0.cnHint: 这栋建筑建于上个____之前，老式结构让新型扫描仪无法侦测。
century:0.hook: Behind the oldest wall, a light was blinking.
century:0.line: 'This block stood for a *century*. Zero knew we'd overlook it,' Grey Crow said.

responsibility:0.en: The server room smelled of burnt circuits. Grey Crow handed me a cracked data-chip. 'This city runs on secrets,' he said. 'Knowing them is a burden.' I held the chip. The *responsibility* of what I now carried settled on my shoulders like cold iron.
responsibility:0.cnHint: 灰鸦将一枚数据芯片交给我，告诉我承担这份____意味着什么。
responsibility:0.hook: The chip began to pulse — someone else knew I had it.
responsibility:0.line: 'You accepted the chip, so the *responsibility* is yours now.'

soon:0.en: Ali pressed her back against the wall. The power had died three minutes ago. Emergency lights flickered once, then quit. 'They will find the terminal *soon*,' she whispered, eyes fixed on the dark corridor. I checked my scanner. Four signals, moving fast, closing in from the east stairwell.
soon:0.cnHint: 停电后，阿栗警告我敌人____就会找到终端机。
soon:0.hook: The scanner beeped once — then went silent forever.
soon:0.line: 'Move now. They will be here *soon*, and we are not ready.'

center:0.en: The blackout map Grey Crow sent showed a perfect ring of dead zones across Harbor City. Every ring pointed inward. I traced the lines with my finger until they met. The *center* was Sub-Level Nine — the place the city's official records said did not exist.
center:0.cnHint: 停电区域的____指向一个官方记录中根本不存在的地点。
center:0.hook: My access card unlocked a door that should have had no lock.
center:0.line: 'Everything leads to the *center* — and the center is buried deep.'

arrive:0.en: Zero's message came through as static, then cleared into three words: 'Do not wait.' I was already moving through the flooded basement corridor, knee-deep in black water. I had to *arrive* at the relay node before the backup grid died and took the only evidence with it.
arrive:0.cnHint: 我必须在备用电网彻底断掉之前____到中继节点。
arrive:0.hook: Behind me, a door I had just passed swung open on its own.
arrive:0.line: 'If you do not *arrive* in four minutes, I pull the signal myself.'

boost:0.en: Ali spliced two dead cables together with bare hands. The monitor on the wall blinked, then lit up — weak, grey, but alive. 'Signal is at twelve percent,' she said. 'Not enough.' She crossed two more wires and the reading jumped. That rough *boost* bought us sixty seconds of transmission time.
boost:0.cnHint: 阿栗用双手硬接电缆，给信号一个粗糙的____，争取到了六十秒。
boost:0.hook: Sixty seconds was just long enough for Zero to trace us back.
boost:0.line: 'Give the signal a *boost* — twelve percent will get us killed.'

conflict:0.en: Grey Crow's orders said hold position. Zero's intercepted broadcast said the node would wipe itself in minutes. The two commands *conflict* inside my head, loud as crossed radio frequencies. Ali looked at me. She did not speak. The silence meant: choose, and choose fast, because the clock has no opinion.
conflict:0.cnHint: 两道指令在我脑中____，阿栗沉默地看着我等待决断。
conflict:0.hook: I chose — and heard Grey Crow's sharp intake of breath.
conflict:0.line: 'These two orders *conflict* — someone up the chain is lying to us.'

demand:0.en: The locked console blinked a single prompt. I typed my clearance code. It rejected it. Typed it again. Rejected. Then a voice came through the speaker — calm, flat, synthetic. It did not ask. It did not suggest. It *demand*ed a second key, one that Grey Crow had never told me existed.
demand:0.cnHint: 控制台拒绝了我的权限码，并用合成声音____一把我从未听说过的第二密钥。
demand:0.hook: The only person who held that second key was Zero.
demand:0.line: 'The system will *demand* a second key — Grey Crow hid that from you.'

emotion:0.en: Ali found the old photo pinned inside the relay cabinet — a younger Grey Crow, smiling, beside someone whose face had been burned away. She held it toward me without a word. I felt something move in my chest, unwelcome and sharp. *Emotion* had no place in a dead server room at midnight.
emotion:0.cnHint: 阿栗在机柜里发现了一张旧照片，我心中涌起不合时宜的____。
emotion:0.hook: The burned face in the photo matched the voice we had just heard.
emotion:0.line: 'I have no time for *emotion* — but that face changes everything.'

international:0.en: The blackout had lasted three hours. In the basement server room, I found a humming terminal still alive on backup power. Its screen showed an *international* relay map — signal threads crossing a dozen countries, all converging on Harbor City. Someone was routing a broadcast through half the world to hide its true source.
international:0.cnHint: 备用电源下，屏幕上出现了一张____中继地图，信号从十几个国家汇聚而来。
international:0.hook: Every thread led to the same blinking node — right beneath us.
international:0.line: 'This is *international* traffic — someone very far away is watching us.'

outside:0.en: Every window in the control room was painted black — regulation paint, applied after the last riot. I pressed my ear to the cold glass anyway. From the *outside* came a low hum, rhythmic and mechanical, like a generator that should not have been running. The building had no listed backup unit on that side.
outside:0.cnHint: 控制室的窗户全被涂黑，但我从____听到了一台本不该存在的发电机声。
outside:0.hook: The hum stopped the instant I touched the window latch.
outside:0.line: 'Stay here — I need to check what is on the *outside*.'

fun:0.en: Zero had left a message on the dead monitor: three words and a small drawn face. 'Having any *fun*?' The letters were neat, unhurried. He had been here long enough to write calmly in the dark, which meant he had planned the blackout himself. I photographed it and felt a cold respect I did not want to feel.
fun:0.cnHint: 零点在黑屏上留下挑衅留言，问我有没有____，字迹从容，说明一切都在他掌控之中。
fun:0.hook: The drawn face was still smiling, and somehow that was worse.
fun:0.line: '*Fun*? He thinks this whole night is a game for him.'

reality:0.en: Grey Crow had briefed me on the theory: a signal hidden inside city power fluctuations, invisible to standard scanners. Standing in the humming relay vault, I finally grasped the *reality* — the grid itself was a transmitter. Every lamp, every screen, every socket in Harbor City had been carrying that signal for months.
reality:0.cnHint: 灰鸦的推断终于得到验证，____是：整个城市电网本身就是一台发射器。
reality:0.hook: And whoever built it could turn the city dark with a single keystroke.
reality:0.line: 'The *reality* is harder to accept than anything I warned you about.'

beyond:0.en: Ali spread the decoded map across the floor. The signal network we had traced covered Harbor City's nine districts — but three nodes sat *beyond* the city boundary, out in the flooded industrial belt where no authority had jurisdiction. My hands felt cold. We had been thinking too small the entire time.
beyond:0.cnHint: 信号网络延伸到了城市边界____，进入无人管辖的工业废区，我们一直低估了对手的规模。
beyond:0.hook: Ali looked up and said nothing, which was answer enough.
beyond:0.line: 'It goes *beyond* the city — our search area just tripled.'

completely:0.en: I rebooted the secondary console and watched the screen fill with rolling code. Then it cleared — *completely*, every line gone, as if the system had inhaled and held its breath. No error message. No cursor. Just a blank white field that reflected my own face back at me, waiting.
completely:0.cnHint: 重启后控制台屏幕____清空，没有任何报错，只剩下空白，令人不安。
completely:0.hook: A single new line appeared: 'Hello, investigator. I have been expecting this.'
completely:0.line: 'The logs are *completely* wiped — someone got here before us.'

advise:0.en: Grey Crow's voice came through the earpiece, low and even. He had seen the vault schematics before, years ago, under a different case. 'I *advise* you to leave the drive where it is,' he said. 'If you pull it now, the whole log chain collapses and Zero walks free.' My fingers stopped one centimetre from the port.
advise:0.cnHint: 灰鸦通过耳机____我不要拔出那个驱动器，否则证据链将彻底断裂。
advise:0.hook: Somewhere in the dark behind me, a footstep landed on metal.
advise:0.line: 'I *advise* you to trust me on this — do not touch that drive.'

management:0.en: The server room was cold and humming. Grey Crow pulled up a chair. 'The building *management* cuts power every night at midnight,' he said, 'to hide what runs on floor nine.' I checked my watch. Eleven fifty-eight. The lights were already beginning to flicker.
management:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳告诉我，大楼____每晚切断电源，是为了掩盖九楼的秘密。
management:0.hook: Two minutes left, and the door behind us just locked.
management:0.line: 'The *management* controls more than just the lights.'

perfect:0.en: Ali spread the stolen floor plan across the table. Every exit, every camera angle, every blind spot was marked. 'It looks *perfect*,' I said. She did not smile. She tapped a small square near the east stairwell — unmarked, unexplained. Something had been left off this map on purpose.
perfect:0.cnHint: 阿里展开楼层图，我觉得计划____无缺，但她发现了一处刻意隐去的标记。
perfect:0.hook: Whatever was hidden in that square, someone did not want us to find it.
perfect:0.line: 'A *perfect* map with one missing room is not perfect at all.'

along:0.en: I moved *along* the dark corridor, one hand on the cold wall, the other holding a dim signal reader. Each step brought a new burst of static. Grey Crow had warned me: the hidden broadcast grew stronger the deeper you went. The signal was now almost screaming.
along:0.cnHint: 我____走廊摸黑前行，信号读取器的静电噪声越来越响。
along:0.hook: Then the signal stopped, and something ahead of me moved.
along:0.line: 'Move *along* the left wall — cameras skip that side.'

harm:0.en: Zero's voice came through the broken intercom, calm and low. 'I will not *harm* you,' he said. 'I only need the frequency you are carrying.' Ali grabbed my arm. We both knew the same truth: anyone who opens with that sentence has already planned exactly the opposite.
harm:0.cnHint: 零点通过对讲机说他不会____我们，但阿里和我都不相信他。
harm:0.hook: The intercom clicked off, and our door handle began to turn.
harm:0.line: 'I will not *harm* you — I simply need what is inside your coat.'

increasingly:0.en: The backup generator coughed on, throwing red light across the room. Grey Crow's coded map was *increasingly* hard to read — each power cut scrambled one more layer of its hidden ink. We had perhaps three minutes before the next blackout swallowed the last visible line.
increasingly:0.cnHint: 停电使格雷·克劳的密码地图____难以辨认，我们只剩几分钟。
increasingly:0.hook: The third blackout would erase the map — and our only way out.
increasingly:0.line: 'The signal is *increasingly* unstable — we are running out of time.'

opinion:0.en: 'In my *opinion*,' Ali said, pressing her ear to the ventilation panel, 'the broadcast is not coming from below — it is coming from this floor.' I had assumed basement level all night. If she was right, every move we had made was aimed at the wrong place.
opinion:0.cnHint: 阿里发表____，认为神秘广播就在我们所在的楼层，而不是地下室。
opinion:0.hook: A footstep creaked directly above the panel she was touching.
opinion:0.line: 'My *opinion* is that someone on this floor is still transmitting.'

previous:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a thin file. 'Read the *previous* investigator's notes,' he said quietly. I opened the first page. The handwriting stopped mid-sentence, mid-word, as if the writer had simply ceased to exist. The date on the paper was last Tuesday. That was four days ago.
previous:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳让我读____调查员的笔记，但那些文字在半句话处骤然中断。
previous:0.hook: The last word written was my own name.
previous:0.line: 'The *previous* investigator found this room — and was never seen again.'

aim:0.en: Zero stepped out of the shadows, a small device in his hand. 'My *aim* is simple,' he said. 'Take the signal core, walk away, forget this building.' His voice was steady. His eyes were not. Whatever his real aim was, it was buried several layers beneath those words.
aim:0.cnHint: 零点现身，声称他的____很简单，但他的眼神出卖了他真实的意图。
aim:0.hook: He raised the device, and every light in the room died at once.
aim:0.line: 'My *aim* tonight is the signal core — nothing more, nothing less.'

model:0.en: The lab was dark except for one glowing screen. On it spun a 3-D *model* of Harbor City's power grid — every cable, every node. Grey Crow leaned close. 'Someone rebuilt the whole city in code,' he said. Outside, the first lights began to die, block by block.
model:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳盯着屏幕上城市电网的____，此时窗外的灯光正在逐一熄灭。
model:0.hook: The model showed one node still live — deep underground.
model:0.line: 'This *model* was built by someone who knows every wire in the city.'

spot:0.en: The server room hummed in the dark. I swept my torch across rows of blinking machines and managed to *spot* a small red mark on the third rack — a circle with a slash, the same sign Zero always left. My pulse jumped. He had been here within the hour.
spot:0.cnHint: 我在黑暗的服务器室里____了零点留下的暗号，他刚刚离开不久。
spot:0.hook: Then the humming stopped, and I was not alone.
spot:0.line: 'I can *spot* his mark anywhere — trust me.'

achievement:0.en: Ali slapped a printed sheet on the table. It listed every blackout in Harbor City over ten years, with dates and durations. 'This is Zero's greatest *achievement*,' she said, voice flat. 'Each cut was a test. Tonight is the real thing.' The ceiling light flickered once, then died.
achievement:0.cnHint: 阿里将零点历次断电行动的记录摆在桌上，称其为他最大的____。
achievement:0.hook: The last entry on the list was dated — tonight.
achievement:0.line: 'An *achievement* like this takes years of quiet planning.'

enter:0.en: The door to the control room had no handle, only a keypad glowing faint green. Grey Crow handed me a slip of paper — six digits. 'Type it and *enter*,' he said. My fingers were cold. The moment I pressed the last key, alarms screamed through the floor above us.
enter:0.cnHint: 我按下密码____控制室，警报声随即在楼上炸响。
enter:0.hook: Grey Crow grabbed my arm: 'Wrong floor — run.'
enter:0.line: '*Enter* the code slowly, or the system locks us out.'

eye:0.en: The backup lights cast everything in red. I kept my *eye* on the narrow corridor ahead, watching for movement. Ali stood behind me, barely breathing. A shadow crossed the far wall — too tall for a guard, too fast for a civilian. It paused, as if it knew we were there.
eye:0.cnHint: 我用____盯着走廊，一个陌生的身影在尽头停了下来。
eye:0.hook: The shadow turned, and I saw it had no badge.
eye:0.line: 'Keep your *eye* on the door — something is coming.'

shift:0.en: At midnight the mood in the monitoring station changed. Grey Crow noticed the *shift* first — the duty officer stopped typing, folded his hands, and stared at nothing. Ali whispered that three other staff had done the same thing an hour ago. Someone had sent a signal only they could hear.
shift:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳最先注意到值班室里人们行为的____，这背后似乎有一道隐藏的信号。
shift:0.hook: Grey Crow mouthed two words: 'They're compromised.'
shift:0.line: 'The *shift* in their eyes happened at exactly midnight.'

agree:0.en: 'We split up,' I said. Ali shook her head hard. Grey Crow looked at us both, then spoke quietly. 'I *agree* with her — splitting up is how people disappear in Harbor City.' He checked the corridor, then added, 'We move as one, we leave as one.' Nobody argued after that.
agree:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳____了阿里的意见，坚持三人必须一起行动。
agree:0.hook: A door slammed somewhere below, and we stopped breathing.
agree:0.line: 'I *agree* — alone in this building is a death sentence.'

aware:0.en: I pulled up the building's floor plan on my wrist screen. Grey Crow studied it without a word, then tapped a corridor we had all ignored. 'Be *aware* — this passage doesn't appear on the public map,' he said. It led straight to the city's main relay switch. Zero had planned every step.
aware:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳提醒我们要____一条不在公开地图上的隐藏通道。
aware:0.hook: The passage was already open — from the inside.
aware:0.line: 'Stay *aware*: Zero knows this building better than we do.'

relate:0.en: The blackout hit at midnight. Grey Crow pulled me into a server room, its walls lined with dead screens. 'I need you to *relate* every signal you caught before the grid died,' he said, low and steady. I opened my mouth. Nothing came. The data was gone from my head.
relate:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要我____停电前捕获的每一个信号，但我的记忆出现了空白。
relate:0.hook: Someone had wiped my memory — from the inside.
relate:0.line: '*Relate* every signal you heard, and do it fast.'

attitude:0.en: Ali sat across from me in the dim safe room, arms folded, jaw tight. Her *attitude* was hard as the steel walls around us — she trusted no one tonight, not even me. A faint hum rose from the floor. We both froze. The building should have been empty.
attitude:0.cnHint: 停电后的藏身室里，阿里的____让我感到一种从未有过的寒意。
attitude:0.hook: The hum grew louder, and it had a rhythm.
attitude:0.line: 'Your *attitude* tells me you already know what is in that file.'

fill:0.en: Emergency lanterns cast orange light across the corridor. I grabbed every spare data chip I could find and began to *fill* my coat pockets, one slot at a time. Grey Crow watched from the doorway, silent. Outside, boots hit the wet pavement. They were already on our floor.
fill:0.cnHint: 我拼命用数据芯片____口袋，但走廊尽头的脚步声越来越近。
fill:0.hook: The last chip clicked in just as the door handle turned.
fill:0.line: '*Fill* your pockets and do not look back.'

ignore:0.en: Zero's voice crackled through the broken intercom, smooth and cold. 'I know you can hear me.' I pressed my back against the wall and tried to *ignore* the sound, but each word landed like a pin in soft skin. Ali grabbed my sleeve. Her eyes said: do not answer.
ignore:0.cnHint: 零点的声音从损坏的对讲机里传来，我努力____它，却发现根本做不到。
ignore:0.hook: Then the intercom clicked off — and the knocking began.
ignore:0.line: 'You can *ignore* me, but you cannot ignore what I know.'

necessary:0.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn map on the table. 'Cut the backup power. It is *necessary* if we want to reach the relay node before Zero does.' The room smelled of burnt wire. Ali traced a route with her finger and stopped. There was a locked sub-level no one had mapped.
necessary:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说切断备用电源是____的，但地图上出现了一个没人知道的楼层。
necessary:0.hook: The sub-level was not on any official blueprint.
necessary:0.line: 'It is *necessary* — without this step, we lose everything.'

definitely:0.en: I stared at the line of code on the cracked tablet. Someone had planted it hours before the blackout — the timestamp *definitely* placed it before any of us arrived. That meant the trap was set for us specifically. Ali went pale. Grey Crow said nothing and put on his gloves.
definitely:0.cnHint: 时间戳____证明陷阱在我们到达之前就已经布好，阿里的脸色瞬间变白。
definitely:0.hook: Grey Crow's silence was the most frightening answer of all.
definitely:0.line: 'This timestamp *definitely* means someone knew we were coming.'

forget:0.en: 'Do not *forget* the secondary exit,' Grey Crow said, then slipped into the dark hallway without another word. I repeated the route in my head three times. But when the alarm shrieked and red light flooded the room, every step vanished. I was standing still while the others were already running.
forget:0.cnHint: 灰鸦叮嘱我不要____备用出口，但警报响起的瞬间，我的脑子一片空白。
forget:0.hook: Red light, blank mind, and zero seconds left.
forget:0.line: 'Do not *forget* — the secondary exit, third door, turn left.'

particularly:0.en: The safe room was cold, but the corner where the old terminal sat felt *particularly* cold — a sharp, focused chill that had no reason to be there. Ali knelt beside it and pressed her ear to the casing. I watched the screen flicker once, twice, then show a single line of text no one had typed.
particularly:0.cnHint: 旧终端所在的角落____寒冷，屏幕上突然出现了一行没人输入过的文字。
particularly:0.hook: The text read: 'I have been waiting for you.'
particularly:0.line: 'That corner is *particularly* cold — something is still running in there.'

meanwhile:0.en: The server room was dark. I pressed my back against the cold rack and counted the seconds. Somewhere above, Zero was cutting the main power line. *Meanwhile*, Ali rerouted the backup signal through a hidden node, buying us exactly ninety seconds before the whole grid went black.
meanwhile:0.cnHint: 停电前，阿栗在____里悄悄重新接通了备用信号。
meanwhile:0.hook: The ninety seconds ran out, and something moved in the dark.
meanwhile:0.line: '*Meanwhile*, keep your hand on that switch — do not let go.'

damage:0.en: I pulled the data chip from the cracked terminal. The screen was split, the casing scorched. Grey Crow leaned over my shoulder and hissed through his teeth. 'Look at the *damage*,' he said. Every file we needed had been wiped, deliberately, in the last ten minutes before the blackout hit.
damage:0.cnHint: 停电前有人故意对终端造成了____，关键文件全部消失。
damage:0.hook: One file remained — and it had my name on it.
damage:0.line: 'The *damage* is too clean — someone knew exactly what to erase.'

police:0.en: The scanner on Ali's wrist blinked red twice. *Police* drones were sweeping the block in a grid pattern, their blue lights sliding under the door like cold water. I killed my flashlight. We had maybe forty seconds before the sweep reached our floor and the door lock logged our presence.
police:0.cnHint: ____的无人机正在逐层扫描，我们只有四十秒。
police:0.hook: Forty seconds became twenty, and Ali stopped breathing.
police:0.line: 'The *police* pattern changed — they are not doing a routine sweep.'

race:0.en: Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'The firewall closes in three minutes.' It was a *race* between my fingers and the countdown timer burning red on the screen. Ali fed me each password fragment one by one. Two minutes. One. I hit the final key and waited for the click.
race:0.cnHint: 我们和倒计时展开了一场____，每一秒都像一把刀。
race:0.line: 'This is a *race* we cannot afford to lose — type faster.'

medical:0.en: Behind the filing cabinet I found a locked case marked with a white cross. Inside, rows of vials sat in foam — but nothing here matched any *medical* supply list I had ever seen. The labels were in a code Grey Crow did not recognise. Whatever these were, they were not meant to heal.
medical:0.cnHint: 那个标着白十字的箱子里装的根本不是正规____用品。
medical:0.hook: One vial was missing, and the foam was still warm.
medical:0.line: 'No *medical* team ordered these — someone moved them here tonight.'

wear:0.en: Ali pointed her light at the door hinge. The *wear* on the metal was fresh — bright silver scratches cutting through years of rust. This door had been forced open recently, maybe within the hour. I touched the marks with one finger and felt fine dust still falling from the frame.
wear:0.cnHint: 门铰链上新鲜的____痕迹说明有人刚刚破门而入。
wear:0.hook: From the other side of the door came a slow, quiet knock.
wear:0.line: 'That *wear* is fresh — whoever opened it did not have a key.'

climate:0.en: The building's old climate unit was still running, pushing stale cold air through the vents. Grey Crow said the *climate* in this district had been wrong for weeks — not the weather, but the mood: informants going silent, signals rerouting for no reason. Tonight felt like the end of a long held breath.
climate:0.cnHint: 这栋楼里不只是空气让人不安，整个街区的____都已经悄悄改变。
climate:0.hook: Then every vent in the room fell silent at once.
climate:0.line: 'The *climate* here shifted two weeks ago — someone gave an order.'

head:0.en: Zero stepped from the shadows at the far end of the corridor. I had never seen his face before — only heard his name in scrambled signals. He was taller than I expected, and he moved like a man who never looked behind him. He was the *head* of the whole network, and he was smiling.
head:0.cnHint: 走廊尽头的人正是整个网络的____，他的出现让一切计划动摇。
head:0.hook: He said my real name — the one no file was supposed to hold.
head:0.line: 'I am the *head* of this operation, and you were expected.'

return:0.en: The power died at 23:00. Every screen in the building went black. I pressed the emergency switch and waited for the *return* of the backup grid. Thirty seconds. A minute. The room stayed dark. Then Grey Crow's voice cut through the silence from somewhere above me.
return:0.cnHint: 大楼断电后，备用电网迟迟没有____，黑暗中灰鸦的声音突然从头顶传来。
return:0.hook: Something moved in the dark before the lights came back.
return:0.line: 'The *return* of the grid should take ten seconds — not sixty.'

remove:0.en: Ali knelt beside the server rack and worked fast. 'We have to *remove* the chip before Zero traces the signal back here,' she said. Her hands were steady. Mine were not. A soft ping came from the hallway outside — one short tone, then silence.
remove:0.cnHint: 阿栗争分夺秒地试图____芯片，走廊里却传来了一声短促的提示音。
remove:0.hook: That ping meant someone was already at the door.
remove:0.line: '*Remove* the chip now, or we lose everything in this room.'

colleague:0.en: I found the note on my desk when the emergency lights flickered on. Three words: 'Trust no *colleague*.' No name, no time, no reason. I looked across the dim office at the only other person still in the building. She was already looking back at me.
colleague:0.cnHint: 应急灯亮起的瞬间，我的桌上出现了一张纸条，警告我不要相信任何____。
colleague:0.hook: She smiled, and that smile made everything worse.
colleague:0.line: 'A *colleague* left that note — or someone pretending to be one.'

normal:0.en: Grey Crow checked the monitor twice. 'Readings look *normal*,' he said, but his jaw was tight. I had learned to read the gap between his words and his face. The readings were not normal. Something was cycling through the ventilation system that had no name in any log.
normal:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说数据____，但他的表情出卖了他——通风系统里有不明物质在流动。
normal:0.hook: The air in the room tasted faintly of burnt wire.
normal:0.line: 'Nothing about tonight is *normal*, whatever the monitor says.'

succeed:0.en: Zero had tried three times to break the firewall. Each attempt failed. I watched the counters reset and felt the cold knowledge that if she did *succeed*, every name in the network — including mine — would surface in open city broadcasts within minutes.
succeed:0.cnHint: 零点三次攻击防火墙均告失败，但一旦____，网络中所有人的名字都将曝光。
succeed:0.hook: The fourth attempt began before I could close the channel.
succeed:0.line: 'She will *succeed* on the next try — I have seen her work before.'

image:0.en: The projector threw a grainy *image* onto the wall: a face, half hidden by a hood, caught by a corridor sensor two floors up. Ali zoomed in. The jaw line, the way the shoulder sat — I had seen them before, a long time ago, in a different city.
image:0.cnHint: 投影仪在墙上投出一张模糊的____，阿栗放大后，我认出了那张脸。
image:0.hook: My hands went cold before my mind caught up with my eyes.
image:0.line: 'That *image* was captured eleven minutes ago — right above us.'

ourselves:0.en: The exit door was sealed from outside. Ali rattled the handle once, then stopped. 'We locked *ourselves* in,' she said flatly. I checked the window — mesh wire, four floors down, rain hammering the glass. Grey Crow said nothing. He was already pulling up the shaft cover in the floor.
ourselves:0.cnHint: 出口被封死，我们把____锁在了里面，灰鸦却已经开始撬地板上的管道盖。
ourselves:0.hook: The shaft below was dark, and something was climbing up.
ourselves:0.line: 'We only have *ourselves* to blame — and about ninety seconds to fix it.'

catch:0.en: I ran. The corridor twisted left, then right, past dead screens and dripping pipes. I could hear Zero's steps close behind, steady and unhurried, as if she knew the building better than I did. I had one chance: reach the stairwell and *catch* the freight lift before it locked.
catch:0.cnHint: 我在走廊里拼命奔跑，试图____货运电梯，零点的脚步声紧随其后。
catch:0.hook: The lift doors began to close three seconds too soon.
catch:0.line: '*Catch* that lift or we are both trapped on this floor tonight.'

mistake:0.en: The server room hummed beneath the dead city lights. I checked the access log twice. Someone had entered the wrong code — not once, but in a pattern. 'This was no accident,' Grey Crow said quietly. 'Every *mistake* here is a door.' I stared at the blinking cursor and felt the floor shift.
mistake:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，服务器室里的每一个____都是一扇隐藏的门。
mistake:0.hook: The pattern spelled a name I was never meant to read.
mistake:0.line: 'Every *mistake* here is a door — find who left it open.'

staff:0.en: The blackout hit at midnight. Emergency lights turned the office a sick red. All the *staff* had gone home except one — a figure still seated at the far desk, motionless, facing a screen that should have been dark. Ali grabbed my arm. 'That person was not here an hour ago.'
staff:0.cnHint: 停电后，办公室里所有____都已离开，但角落里还坐着一个陌生的身影。
staff:0.hook: The figure turned its head before I made a single sound.
staff:0.line: 'The *staff* all left — so who is sitting at that desk?'

enhance:0.en: Zero's voice came through the broken speaker in bursts. 'They used the blackout to *enhance* the signal — push it past every filter.' I pulled up the frequency map on my handheld. The spike was enormous, city-wide, and it had been running for exactly four minutes before the power died.
enhance:0.cnHint: 零点说，对手趁着断电____了信号，把它推送到整座城市。
enhance:0.hook: Four minutes was enough to rewrite every locked file downtown.
enhance:0.line: 'They used the dark to *enhance* the signal beyond every wall.'

famous:0.en: On the wall of the basement lab hung a single photo — faded, cracked at the corner. Grey Crow tapped the glass. 'He was *famous* once, before the city buried his name.' The face in the photo matched no record I had ever seen. Outside, the rain hammered the street like a warning.
famous:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指着照片说，这个人曾经很____，但这座城市把他的名字抹去了。
famous:0.hook: The man in the photo was standing right behind us.
famous:0.line: 'He was *famous* once — now the city acts like he never lived.'

project:0.en: A folder sat open on the dusty desk, its pages still warm from the printer. I read the cover line: HARBOR CLEAN SIGNAL — PHASE THREE. Ali whispered, 'This *project* is the reason the grid went dark tonight.' Every name on the list was a person I thought was on our side.
project:0.cnHint: 阿栗低声说，正是这个____导致了今晚的全城断电。
project:0.hook: My own code name was printed on the final page.
project:0.line: 'This *project* didn't just kill the lights — it killed our cover.'

record:0.en: The archive drawer was forced open, its lock bent clean. Inside, every physical *record* had been pulled and replaced with blank cards — every one except a single disc taped to the back panel. Grey Crow held it to the red emergency light and said nothing for a long time.
record:0.cnHint: 档案抽屉被撬开，所有的____都被换成了空白卡片，只剩一张光盘。
record:0.hook: Whatever was on that disc, someone had killed for it tonight.
record:0.line: 'Every *record* is gone — except the one they wanted us to find.'

regular:0.en: I had walked this corridor a hundred times. The *regular* hum of the cooling fans, the green blink of the sensor strip, the faint smell of burnt plastic — all gone. In the silence Ali said, 'When the ordinary things vanish, the trap is already closed.' The door at the end opened by itself.
regular:0.cnHint: 走廊里____的机器声和绿灯全都消失了，阿栗说陷阱已经合上了。
regular:0.hook: The door that opened by itself had no handle on our side.
regular:0.line: 'The *regular* sounds are gone — we walked straight into it.'

security:0.en: The *security* desk sat empty, its monitors cycling through empty hallways on loop. Too clean, too quiet. Zero's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'A real guard leaves coffee, a coat, a mess. This is a set.' I looked at the camera above the desk. Its red light was on. It was watching us back.
security:0.cnHint: 保安台空无一人，零点说这里的____布置根本不像真实的岗位。
security:0.hook: The camera tilted slowly, following only me.
security:0.line: 'Real *security* leaves a mess — this room is a stage.'

whatever:0.en: The server room was cold and dark. Every screen had gone dead. Ali pressed her back against the rack and whispered, '*Whatever* signal Grey Crow sent us, it cut the power to the whole block. We had maybe three minutes before the backup lights found us.'
whatever:0.cnHint: 阿栗告诉我，____信号切断了整栋楼的电源，我们只剩三分钟。
whatever:0.hook: Something moved in the dark at the far end of the rack.
whatever:0.line: '*Whatever* he sent us, it just killed every light on this floor.'

predict:0.en: Grey Crow had told me to trust the numbers. 'I can *predict* a blackout window of four minutes,' he said over the static line, 'but after that the system reboots and sees everything.' I copied the files fast, hands shaking, the cursor blinking like a warning eye.
predict:0.cnHint: 灰鸦能____停电的时间窗口，但我们必须在系统重启前完成复制。
predict:0.hook: The cursor stopped blinking — the reboot had started early.
predict:0.line: 'I can *predict* four minutes of darkness, not a second more.'

road:0.en: The map on my screen showed one exit: a service *road* running behind the data center, hidden under a broken streetlight. Ali had already marked it in red. 'That is our only way out,' she said. The door at the end of the hall clicked open on its own.
road:0.cnHint: 地图上只有一条____能让我们离开数据中心，但那扇门突然自己开了。
road:0.hook: Footsteps — steady and slow — came down that hall toward us.
road:0.line: 'That service *road* behind the building — it is the only way out.'

solution:0.en: Zero's voice cut through the broken speaker above us. 'There is no *solution* that saves you and the data both,' he said. I looked at Ali. She looked at the drive in her hand. The room felt smaller. Rain hit the one high window like small, cold fists.
solution:0.cnHint: 零点通过广播告诉我们，没有____能同时保住我们和数据。
solution:0.hook: Ali's hand moved toward the drive — and then stopped.
solution:0.line: 'There is no *solution* here that keeps you both safe.'

total:0.en: The diagnostic screen blinked one word: FAILURE. *Total* silence followed — no fans, no hum, no signal. Ali checked her device twice. Zero had not just cut the power; he had erased every process running in the building. We were blind, deaf, and completely alone inside the dark block.
total:0.cnHint: 系统显示____失败，零点不只是断电，而是抹去了楼内所有运行中的程序。
total:0.hook: Then one small red light came on — and it was not ours.
total:0.line: '*Total* silence means he did not just cut power — he wiped everything.'

fail:0.en: Grey Crow had built three backup paths into the network. One by one I watched them *fail*. The progress bar froze at sixty percent. Ali pressed close and read the error code out loud, her voice flat and steady, the way people sound when they are trying very hard not to be afraid.
fail:0.cnHint: 灰鸦设计的三条备用路径一一____，进度条在60%处停住了。
fail:0.hook: The error code Ali read was not in any manual I had ever seen.
fail:0.line: 'All three paths *fail* — Grey Crow said that should not be possible.'

function:0.en: I found the terminal in the back corner and typed fast. One command. Two. Nothing ran. 'The core *function* is locked,' Ali said from behind me, reading the screen over my shoulder. 'Zero put a key inside it that we do not have.' The rain outside grew louder, as if the city itself was listening.
function:0.cnHint: 终端的核心____被锁住了，零点在里面放了一把我们没有的密钥。
function:0.hook: Then a single line of new code appeared — typed by no one in the room.
function:0.line: 'The core *function* is locked — Zero left a key we cannot touch.'

method:0.en: 'Every *method* I know needs a live connection,' Ali said, pulling her kit from the bag. Grey Crow had gone quiet on the line. The backup power was draining fast. I looked at the door, then at the kit, then at the single blinking port on the dead server in front of us.
method:0.cnHint: 阿栗说她知道的每一种____都需要网络连接，但现在连接已经断了。
method:0.hook: Grey Crow's silence on the line was the loudest sound in the room.
method:0.line: 'Every *method* I know needs a live connection — and we have none.'

review:0.en: The blackout hit at midnight. I spread my old case files across the floor and began a slow *review* of every signal intercepted in Harbor City that week. Something in the data felt wrong — a pattern too clean, too deliberate. Grey Crow had warned me: the answer was already here, hiding in plain sight.
review:0.cnHint: 叙述者在断电之夜重新____所有截获的信号档案，发现数据中藏着一个可疑的规律。
review:0.hook: The pattern spelled a name I was not meant to find.
review:0.line: Grey Crow said, 'A careful *review* now saves your life later.'

ahead:0.en: The corridor stretched dark and silent. Ali held her light low and moved *ahead* of me, step by careful step. Somewhere in the building, a server was still running — its hum a faint pulse in the dead air. Whatever it was storing, Zero wanted it badly enough to cut the whole city's power.
ahead:0.cnHint: 阿栗走在叙述者____，两人在黑暗走廊中悄悄接近那台仍在运转的服务器。
ahead:0.hook: Then Ali stopped, and I heard what she heard — breathing.
ahead:0.line: Ali whispered, 'Stay close. I'll go *ahead* and check.'

cheap:0.en: The safe house was a *cheap* rented room above a noodle shop — bare walls, one broken chair, a window sealed with tape. But the transmitter Grey Crow had hidden behind the vent was anything but simple. Even without power from the grid, it blinked alive on its own small battery.
cheap:0.cnHint: 叙述者躲进一间____的出租屋，却发现藏在通风口后面的发射器仍在运行。
cheap:0.hook: Its screen showed one new message: 'They know where you are.'
cheap:0.line: Grey Crow muttered, 'The room is *cheap*, but the signal is priceless.'

critical:0.en: Every second counted. The backup power would last ten minutes at most, and the *critical* files sat deep inside an encrypted partition. I typed fast, fingers cold, sweat on the keys. One wrong command would wipe everything. Ali stood at the door, counting down in a low, steady voice.
critical:0.cnHint: 叙述者必须在备用电力耗尽前取出那些____文件，一个错误操作就会毁掉全部数据。
critical:0.hook: With two minutes left, the screen flashed a lock I had never seen before.
critical:0.line: Ali said, 'This is the *critical* moment — do not rush it.'

motivate:0.en: I could not understand what would *motivate* Zero to black out an entire city just to reach one server. Grey Crow sat beside the dead monitor, eyes closed, thinking. Outside, the rain hit the glass hard. Inside, the silence between us felt like a held breath waiting to break.
motivate:0.cnHint: 叙述者想不通是什么____零点不惜让全城断电只为接触一台服务器。
motivate:0.hook: Grey Crow opened his eyes and said one quiet word: 'Fear.'
motivate:0.line: Grey Crow asked, 'What could *motivate* someone to take such a risk?'

charge:0.en: My handheld scanner was dying. I found a cracked cable behind the desk and used the room's emergency socket to *charge* it. The socket sparked once, then held. Forty percent battery — enough. Ali watched the door while the device hummed back to life, its screen filling with fresh signal data.
charge:0.cnHint: 叙述者找到一根破损电缆给扫描仪____，设备重新启动后屏幕上出现了新的信号数据。
charge:0.hook: The data showed a signal source directly beneath our feet.
charge:0.line: Ali said, 'Hurry up and *charge* it — we have maybe five minutes.'

complex:0.en: The encryption was more *complex* than anything I had seen before — layer after layer, each one shifting as I worked. Grey Crow leaned over my shoulder and said nothing for a long time. The rain outside grew heavier. The code felt almost alive, rearranging itself to block every path I tried.
complex:0.cnHint: 叙述者面对的加密系统异常____，每破解一层就会自动变换新的防护。
complex:0.hook: Then one layer vanished on its own, and I knew: it was letting me in.
complex:0.line: Grey Crow murmured, 'The structure is *complex*, but it has one weak point.'

itself:0.en: The server room was cold and smelled of burnt plastic. The machine in the corner was running on its own power cell — isolated from the city grid, protecting *itself* even through the blackout. No network cable. No wireless signal. Whatever it held, it was designed to survive everything except a direct hand on the switch.
itself:0.cnHint: 那台服务器与城市电网完全隔离，靠自身电池保护____，断电也无法让它停下来。
itself:0.hook: And someone had already put a hand on that switch tonight.
itself:0.line: Grey Crow said, 'The machine guards *itself* — someone built it to last.'

join:0.en: The blackout hit Harbor City at midnight. Every screen went dark. Grey Crow slid a cable across the wet floor toward me. 'You need to *join* these two relay nodes,' he said, 'or the signal dies and we lose Zero's location for good.'
join:0.cnHint: 断电后，灰鸦要我把两个中继节点____在一起，否则就会失去零点的踪迹。
join:0.hook: My hands shook — one wrong wire and Zero walks free.
join:0.line: '*Join* the cables now, or the signal is gone forever.'

significant:0.en: Ali pulled up a map of the city grid on her cracked tablet. Most blackout zones were random. But one block stayed dark every single night. 'That pattern is *significant*,' she whispered. 'Someone is hiding something big in that building.'
significant:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现停电的规律很____，某个街区每晚都断电，绝非偶然。
significant:0.hook: The building on that block had no registered address.
significant:0.line: 'This is *significant* — no city block goes dark this often by chance.'

step:0.en: The server room was pitch black. I moved slow, listening. Then I heard it — one careful *step* on the metal floor ahead of me. Someone else was already inside, moving toward the core terminal before I could reach it.
step:0.cnHint: 漆黑的服务器室里，我听见前方传来一声____声，有人抢先一步。
step:0.hook: Whoever it was, they knew exactly where to go.
step:0.line: 'One more *step* and I will know you are not on our side.'

unique:0.en: Zero left no fingerprints, no face on any camera. But Ali found one detail: a *unique* flicker in every signal he ever sent — a tiny, repeating error, like a scar in the code. No machine made that pattern. Only one person did.
unique:0.cnHint: 零点的每条信号里都藏着一个____的细微错误，那是他无法掩盖的印记。
unique:0.hook: That scar in the code was about to lead us straight to him.
unique:0.line: 'This glitch is *unique* — it belongs to one person and one person only.'

inside:0.en: The power was out but something was still running *inside* the locked archive room. A thin line of blue light leaked under the door. Grey Crow pressed his ear against it and went very still. Whatever was in there had not stopped working.
inside:0.cnHint: 断电后，封锁档案室的____仍有神秘蓝光，有什么东西还在运转。
inside:0.hook: Grey Crow pulled his hand back from the door and said nothing.
inside:0.line: 'There is still something running *inside* — and it should not be.'

majority:0.en: Ali hacked the city's power log. The *majority* of the blackouts were accidents — broken lines, old cables. But twelve of them matched exactly. Same time, same length, same district. Twelve was not an accident. Twelve was a schedule.
majority:0.cnHint: 停电记录显示，____次断电是意外，但有12次完全吻合，那是有人刻意为之。
majority:0.hook: Someone had been running that schedule for over a year.
majority:0.line: 'The *majority* of these blackouts are cover — look at the twelve that are not.'

notice:0.en: I almost missed it. On the wall above the dead monitor, someone had scratched four numbers into the paint. Small, fast, easy to skip. Grey Crow touched my arm. 'Did you *notice* that?' he asked quietly. Those numbers matched the frequency Zero used last week.
notice:0.cnHint: 我差点错过墙上刻的四个数字，灰鸦提醒我要____到它们。
notice:0.hook: Four numbers — and suddenly the whole blackout made sense.
notice:0.line: '*Notice* the marks on the wall — Zero was here before us.'

taste:0.en: Ali handed me a small metal flask. 'Drink,' she said. 'You look like a dead wire.' The liquid had a sharp, bitter *taste*, like cold circuit solder. But it cleared my head fast. I looked at the broken terminal and finally saw the pattern I had been missing.
taste:0.cnHint: 阿栗递来的饮料____苦涩，但它让我头脑清醒，终于看出了终端机上隐藏的规律。
taste:0.hook: The pattern spelled out a name — and it was mine.
taste:0.line: 'Strange *taste*, right? Grey Crow made it — he said it helps you see clearly.'

describe:0.en: The safe house smelled of old wires and cold rain. Ali spread a city map across the table. 'Try to *describe* the signal you heard,' she said, pressing a recorder toward me. I closed my eyes. The frequency had a shape — sharp, then low, like a broken bell. I spoke slowly. Outside, neon flickered and died.
describe:0.cnHint: 在安全屋里，阿栗要求叙述者用语言____那个神秘信号的特征。
describe:0.hook: Before I finished, the recorder went static — someone was listening.
describe:0.line: 'Try to *describe* the signal — every detail matters tonight.'

rest:0.en: I had not slept in thirty hours. Grey Crow pointed to a cot in the corner of the relay station. 'Take a *rest*,' he said. 'The next broadcast window opens at dawn.' I lay down, coat still on, eyes fixed on the ceiling. The hidden signals kept humming inside my skull. Dawn felt very far away.
rest:0.cnHint: 在中继站，灰鸦建议叙述者先____，等待下一次信号窗口。
rest:0.hook: The moment my eyes closed, the wall screen lit up with a single forbidden word.
rest:0.line: 'Take a *rest* — you are no good to us half-asleep.'

employer:0.en: The file on my desk had no name, only a code. Grey Crow tapped it. 'Your *employer* is not the city bureau,' he said quietly. 'Whoever pays you also paid for the blackout last Tuesday.' My mouth went dry. I had assumed I was working for the right side. The neon outside buzzed like an insect dying.
employer:0.cnHint: 灰鸦暗示叙述者的____其实与上周的大停电有所关联。
employer:0.hook: I looked at my access card — the logo on it had quietly changed.
employer:0.line: 'Your *employer* has been feeding data to Zero all along.'

owner:0.en: The locked room on the fourth floor had no number. Ali found a print record: one registered *owner*, listed only as a signal frequency. 'That is not a person,' I said. 'It is a broadcast address.' She nodded slowly. In Harbor City, a room could belong to a voice, and that voice could belong to no one human at all.
owner:0.cnHint: 四楼那个神秘房间的____竟然只是一个广播地址，而非真实的人。
owner:0.hook: Then the frequency pulsed once — and the door swung open on its own.
owner:0.line: 'The *owner* of this room has never once set foot inside it.'

gender:0.en: The suspect profile on my screen listed every detail — height, district, signal range — but the field marked *gender* was blank, replaced by a string of encrypted zeros. Ali leaned in. 'Zero does that on purpose,' she murmured. 'Makes the profile harder to trace.' Smart. In Harbor City, even identity was a code to be cracked.
gender:0.cnHint: 嫌疑人档案中，有关____的一栏被加密清空，这是零点的惯用手法。
gender:0.hook: I ran a decrypt — and the result matched someone inside our own unit.
gender:0.line: 'The *gender* field is blank — Zero scrubbed it before we got here.'

website:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a printed page — rare in 2099. 'The coded message points to this *website*,' he said. The address was forty characters of random noise. I typed it in. The page that loaded was pure white, one sentence in the center, written in a language that looked like English but meant something else entirely. My hands were not steady.
website:0.cnHint: 灰鸦找到一个隐秘的____，其页面上有一句看似英文却另有含义的神秘话语。
website:0.hook: The sentence changed the moment I read it — as if it knew my eyes were there.
website:0.line: 'This *website* only stays live for sixty seconds — read fast.'

emotional:0.en: Ali said I was too *emotional* for this kind of work. She meant it as a warning, not an insult. 'In Harbor City, feelings are a frequency Zero can detect,' she told me, voice flat. 'Every time you react, you broadcast.' I stared at the rain on the window glass. She was right. I steadied my breathing and turned back to the screen.
emotional:0.cnHint: 阿栗警告叙述者，过于____容易在Harbor City中暴露自己的位置信号。
emotional:0.hook: Right then my pulse monitor beeped — Zero had just picked up a reading.
emotional:0.line: 'Stay calm — being *emotional* in the field is like shouting your location.'

training:0.en: The manual on my screen was thirty pages of signal theory. Grey Crow had assigned it as my night *training* before I ever touched a real case. 'Read it twice,' he had said. Now, alone in the relay room, I recognized the exact pattern from page nine — live, in the walls around me, humming at a frequency that should not exist.
training:0.cnHint: 叙述者在夜间____材料中学到的信号特征，此刻竟真实出现在了房间四壁之中。
training:0.hook: Page nine had one warning printed in red: do not respond to this signal alone.
training:0.line: 'Your *training* covered this — think carefully before you touch that switch.'

land:0.en: The blackout hit at midnight. Every screen in the server hall went dark. Grey Crow spread a paper map across the table. 'This *land* was free once,' he said, tracing the old city borders. 'Before the Signal Lords carved it up.' I stared at the lines and felt something cold move through me.
land:0.cnHint: 停电之夜，灰鸦展开地图，指着这片被信号领主瓜分的____。
land:0.hook: The border he traced — it no longer existed on any official map.
land:0.line: 'This *land* was free once, before they rewrote the maps.'

promote:0.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on the emergency channel. 'They didn't kill the power by accident,' he said. 'The blackout is a move to *promote* fear — to push people off the grid and into the open.' Ali grabbed my arm. Outside, boots hit the wet pavement in a steady rhythm.
promote:0.cnHint: 零点认为断电是有人故意用来____恐慌、将人逼出躲藏地点的手段。
promote:0.hook: Those boots were getting closer, and there was only one door.
promote:0.line: 'They use the dark to *promote* fear and flush us out.'

purchase:0.en: Ali emptied her coat pockets onto the workbench: three signal chips and a cracked reader. 'Last *purchase* before the grid went down,' she said quietly. 'Cost me everything I had left.' The chips glowed faint blue in the dark. If even one of them worked, we had a chance.
purchase:0.cnHint: 阿栗把停电前最后一次____的信号芯片倒在桌上，那是她全部的家底。
purchase:0.hook: One chip was already warm — someone had activated it remotely.
purchase:0.line: 'This *purchase* cost me everything — it had better be worth it.'

rely:0.en: The backup generator coughed once and died. Grey Crow did not even flinch. 'We cannot *rely* on machines tonight,' he said, and pulled a thin wire from his sleeve. He began connecting nodes by hand, reading each pulse with his fingertips. I watched and understood — his body was the machine now.
rely:0.cnHint: 备用发电机熄灭后，灰鸦说今晚不能____机器，开始用手指读取信号。
rely:0.hook: His fingers stopped — he had felt something that should not be there.
rely:0.line: 'We cannot *rely* on any machine they can switch off.'

connect:0.en: 'The signal is broken into pieces,' Ali said, staring at the dark monitor. 'Someone fragmented it on purpose.' Grey Crow nodded slowly. 'Then we *connect* the pieces by hand.' He laid six small devices in a row on the floor, each one a fragment of a larger broadcast. I held my breath.
connect:0.cnHint: 信号被人为切断，灰鸦决定手动____碎片，还原那段隐藏的广播。
connect:0.hook: The moment the last device clicked into place, the room went silent.
connect:0.line: 'We *connect* the pieces by hand — or we never hear the truth.'

indicate:0.en: A thin line of green light blinked on the dead panel. Ali leaned close. 'That pattern — three short, two long — it does not *indicate* a system fault,' she whispered. 'It is a message.' Grey Crow was already writing the pulses down. Someone inside the building was still transmitting, very slowly, very carefully.
indicate:0.cnHint: 控制面板上闪烁的灯光并不____系统故障，阿栗意识到那是一条秘密信息。
indicate:0.hook: The message spelled a name — and it was mine.
indicate:0.line: 'Three short, two long — that does not *indicate* a fault.'

period:0.en: Grey Crow sat back and closed his eyes. 'There is always a *period* of silence before they move,' he said. 'Ten minutes, maybe fifteen. That is the gap they use to reposition.' The room was very quiet. I counted seconds. Ali watched the door. We all knew the silence would not last.
period:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说行动前总有一段____的沉默，那是对方重新部署的空隙。
period:0.hook: At nine minutes, something slid under the door — a folded slip of paper.
period:0.line: 'This *period* of silence — it is not peace, it is preparation.'

picture:0.en: Ali held up a small card she had found taped under the workbench. On it was a rough *picture* — lines and dots that looked like noise but formed a face when you tilted the card. Grey Crow went very still. 'I drew that,' he said softly, 'six years ago. I thought I burned it.'
picture:0.cnHint: 阿栗在工作台下发现一张藏着的____，灰鸦认出那是他六年前亲手画的。
picture:0.hook: If Grey Crow had burned it, someone else had made a perfect copy.
picture:0.line: 'I drew this *picture* six years ago — I watched it burn.'

differ:0.en: The server room smelled of burnt wire. Ali pulled up two maps on her screen. 'These routing paths *differ* in one key way,' she said. One led to the city core. The other looped back to an empty dock. I had thirty seconds to choose.
differ:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现两条路线____，侦探必须迅速做出选择。
differ:0.hook: One path was a trap — but which one?
differ:0.line: 'These two signals *differ* by exactly one node — that node is the target.'

shape:0.en: The blackout hit at midnight. Emergency lights threw long shadows across the walls. In the red glow, Grey Crow traced a *shape* on the frosted glass — a triangle inside a circle. 'This is their mark,' he said quietly. 'It means the drop already happened.'
shape:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在玻璃上画出一个____，表明交易已经完成。
shape:0.hook: If the drop was done, we were already too late.
shape:0.line: 'That *shape* on the wall — someone left it as a warning, not a sign.'

twice:0.en: The terminal blinked *twice* before going dark. Ali grabbed my arm. 'That is a signal,' she whispered. 'One blink means standby. Two means the package has moved.' Somewhere above us, a door slammed. The package was gone, and whoever took it was still in the building.
twice:0.cnHint: 终端闪烁了____，阿栗意识到货物已经转移。
twice:0.hook: Footsteps echoed on the floor above — heavy and fast.
twice:0.line: 'It blinked *twice* — they are already moving the data, right now.'

aspect:0.en: Grey Crow studied the stolen file for a long moment. 'Every *aspect* of this plan points to someone inside,' he said, voice flat. The room was cold. The backup power hummed low. Ali said nothing, but her eyes moved to the door — and the shadow beneath it.
aspect:0.cnHint: 灰鸦分析计划的每个____，怀疑内部有人出卖了我们。
aspect:0.hook: The shadow under the door did not move — it was waiting.
aspect:0.line: 'Every *aspect* of the leak traces back to this room, this team.'

currently:0.en: I jacked into the building's local net. The status screen read: GRID *CURRENTLY* OFFLINE — REROUTING. Zero had cut the main power on purpose. Without the grid, our encrypted channel was dead. Ali typed fast beside me. We had maybe four minutes before the backup battery died too.
currently:0.cnHint: 系统显示电网____离线，零点是故意切断了电源。
currently:0.hook: Four minutes — then we would be blind and silent.
currently:0.line: 'The safe channel is *currently* dead — we have no way to call for help.'

decrease:0.en: Ali watched the battery gauge on the relay box. 'The charge will *decrease* faster now that the cooling fans are off,' she said. Heat was already building in the small room. Grey Crow pressed his back against the wall and closed his eyes, thinking. The gauge dropped another bar.
decrease:0.cnHint: 阿栗警告电量会____得更快，小屋里的热度也在上升。
decrease:0.hook: Grey Crow's eyes snapped open — he had a plan, or a guess.
decrease:0.line: 'If we run two systems at once, power will *decrease* in under three minutes.'

possibility:0.en: Zero left one message on the dead screen: YOU SEE THE *POSSIBILITY*, DON'T YOU. I read it three times. It was not a question. Grey Crow stood at the window, rain streaking the glass. 'He wants you to think there is a way out,' Grey Crow said. 'There is not.'
possibility:0.cnHint: 零点留下的信息暗示侦探已经看到了某种____，但灰鸦发出了警告。
possibility:0.hook: But Grey Crow's hands were shaking — just slightly.
possibility:0.line: 'The only *possibility* left is one that Zero already planned for us.'

crucial:0.en: The access log was half-corrupted, but one line survived. Ali highlighted it. 'This timestamp is *crucial*,' she said. 'It proves someone opened the vault six minutes before the blackout — not during.' That changed everything. The thief had not used the darkness as cover. They had caused it.
crucial:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现日志中一个____的时间戳，证明盗贼在断电前就已行动。
crucial:0.hook: We had been hunting the wrong timeline all night.
crucial:0.line: 'This one line is *crucial* — it means the blackout was never an accident.'

enormous:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Harbor City's grid. Ali pointed her flashlight at the machine in the corner. '*Enormous*,' she whispered. The thing stretched floor to ceiling, its shell cracked open, cables spilling out like cut veins. Someone had been here. Recently.
enormous:0.cnHint: 阿栗在断电的服务器室里发现了一台____的机器，有人刚刚动过它。
enormous:0.line: '*Enormous* — this thing could run the whole city's grid alone.'

pet:0.en: Grey Crow kept a small mechanical bird on his desk — his only *pet*, he once told me. When I found his office dark and empty, the bird was gone too. He never went anywhere without it. That meant he had not left by choice.
pet:0.cnHint: 灰鸦视那只机械鸟为____，但断电后它和主人一起消失了。
pet:0.hook: On the desk, one tiny metal feather remained.
pet:0.line: 'That bird is my *pet* — if it is gone, so is my trust.'

restaurant:0.en: The meeting point was a noodle *restaurant* on Level 4 — cash only, no cameras, steam thick enough to hide a face. I found the table. I found the cold bowl. I did not find Ali. Her jacket hung on the back of the chair.
restaurant:0.cnHint: 我在约定的____里找到了阿栗留下的夹克，却不见她的人。
restaurant:0.hook: The jacket pocket held a folded note, still sealed.
restaurant:0.line: 'This *restaurant* is the one safe place left — or it was.'

driver:0.en: The transit pod sat dark at the curb. Its *driver* — a thin man Zero had sent — stared straight ahead and said nothing. I climbed in. The doors locked. We moved without a destination on the screen. Outside, the city lights died one block at a time.
driver:0.cnHint: 零点派来的____锁上车门，屏幕上没有目的地，城市灯光逐渐熄灭。
driver:0.hook: The door handle came off in my hand.
driver:0.line: 'I am just the *driver* — where we go is not my call.'

dream:0.en: Zero's voice came through the dead speakers somehow. 'You still believe in the old *dream*,' he said, 'that truth can travel free.' The room was cold. The backup lights cast everything red. I realised he had been watching me for longer than one night.
dream:0.cnHint: 零点嘲笑我仍抱有信息自由传播的____，而他一直在监视我。
dream:0.hook: The speakers should have been dead.
dream:0.line: 'Your *dream* of a free signal — I have already killed it.'

consumer:0.en: The file on the cracked screen read: SUBJECT — passive *consumer*, no threat. That was how Zero had classified me. I felt something cold settle in my chest. He thought I was nothing. That was my only advantage now, and I intended to keep it.
consumer:0.cnHint: 零点的档案里把我标记为被动的____，这个误判是我唯一的优势。
consumer:0.hook: I closed the file and left no trace — just as he expected.
consumer:0.line: 'A *consumer* takes what is given — you have never questioned the feed.'

interesting:0.en: Grey Crow's notebook was full of numbers, except one page. On it, a single word: *interesting*. Below it, a list of six names. Mine was last. Ali leaned over my shoulder and went quiet. In Grey Crow's code, that word was never a compliment.
interesting:0.cnHint: 灰鸦的笔记本里有个词____，下面列着六个名字，我排在最后。
interesting:0.hook: Ali said nothing, which told me everything.
interesting:0.line: 'He only wrote *interesting* when someone was already in danger.'

grade:0.en: The security door had a *grade* panel — green for clear, red for threat, white for unknown. I was white. That had never happened to me before. Ali said white meant the system could not place me in any known category. Zero had erased my profile entirely.
grade:0.cnHint: 安全门的____显示我是白色——零点已经彻底抹去了我的身份档案。
grade:0.hook: Without a grade, I did not officially exist.
grade:0.line: 'White *grade* means the city has no record you were ever here.'

decline:0.en: The power grid status board on the wall showed a sharp *decline* in output — forty percent and still falling. Grey Crow tapped the screen with one finger. 'This is no accident,' he said. The backup lights flickered. Somewhere below us, the city was going dark, block by block.
decline:0.cnHint: 墙上的电网状态板显示输出急剧____，灰鸦断定这绝非意外。
decline:0.hook: The next block to go dark was ours.
decline:0.line: 'The *decline* started at midnight — someone planned this.'

extra:0.en: Ali pulled an *extra* power cell from her bag and snapped it into the portable console. 'I always carry one,' she said, not looking up. The room smelled of burnt wire. Outside, rain hammered the window. The console blinked on, and the stolen file began to load.
extra:0.cnHint: 阿栗从包里取出____的电源模块，让控制台重新启动，被盗文件开始加载。
extra:0.hook: The file name on screen made my stomach drop.
extra:0.line: 'Good thing I packed an *extra* — we would be blind right now.'

income:0.en: The encrypted ledger on the screen listed hundreds of accounts. Each one showed a monthly *income* far beyond any legal job in Harbor City. Grey Crow pointed at the top entry. 'That figure,' he said quietly, 'belongs to someone who does not exist on any public record.'
income:0.cnHint: 加密账本上每个账户的____都远超合法工作所得，最上面那条记录属于一个"不存在"的人。
income:0.hook: Grey Crow's finger did not move from that name.
income:0.line: 'An *income* this large means someone very powerful is involved.'

medicine:0.en: A small cabinet in the corner held rows of unlabeled vials. Ali leaned close and read the chemical codes. 'This isn't standard *medicine*,' she said, her voice flat. 'These compounds were banned ten years ago.' The room felt colder suddenly. Someone had been running quiet experiments here for a long time.
medicine:0.cnHint: 角落里的小柜子装满了无标签药瓶，阿栗认出这些并非普通____，而是十年前被禁的化合物。
medicine:0.hook: A log on the shelf showed last use: tonight.
medicine:0.line: 'This is not *medicine* — this is something the city banned long ago.'

private:0.en: The door at the back of the room was sealed with a biometric lock. A small sign read: *PRIVATE* — NO ENTRY. Zero had mentioned a room like this once, almost by accident. I pressed my ear to the cold metal door. Faint sounds came through — keyboard clicks, a low voice, steady breathing.
private:0.cnHint: 房间深处有一扇贴着____标志的生物锁门，零点曾无意中提到过这样一个地方。
private:0.hook: The voice on the other side said my name.
private:0.line: 'That room is *private* — whoever is inside knows we are here.'

side:0.en: Grey Crow moved to the *side* of the main console and pried off a panel with a flat tool. Behind it, a second network port glowed red — a hidden channel running parallel to the official system. 'They built a shadow network inside the real one,' he said. 'Everything sent here never shows up in the logs.'
side:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在主控台____面发现了一个隐藏网络接口，所有经此传输的数据从不留记录。
side:0.hook: The red light blinked once, then someone on the other end disconnected.
side:0.line: 'Check the *side* panel — the real data is hidden behind it.'

air:0.en: The moment Ali cracked the sealed vent, the *air* in the room changed — sharp, chemical, carrying a warning we could not name. Zero had once said that certain labs pump trace signals through the ventilation to detect intruders. I held my breath. The sensor on Ali's wrist began to flash yellow.
air:0.cnHint: 阿栗撬开密封通风口，室内____骤变，阿栗手腕上的传感器随即开始闪烁黄色警报。
air:0.hook: Yellow meant we had roughly ninety seconds to leave.
air:0.line: 'The *air* is wrong — they know someone opened this room.'

consumption:0.en: The energy monitor on the wall logged *consumption* at three times the normal rate for a building this size. Grey Crow scrolled back through the hourly data. The spike had started six days ago and had not stopped. 'Whatever they are running in here,' he said, 'it is hungry and it never sleeps.'
consumption:0.cnHint: 能耗监测仪显示该建筑的____是正常水平的三倍，这种异常已持续六天。
consumption:0.hook: The machine drawing all that power was somewhere below us.
consumption:0.line: '*Consumption* this high means the device runs every hour, without pause.'

evidence:0.en: The power cut hit at midnight. I swept my flashlight across the server room floor. A single data chip, cracked but still warm, lay in the corner. This was the *evidence* I needed — proof that someone had copied the city's voice-filter files just minutes before the blackout.
evidence:0.cnHint: 我在服务器室地板上找到了关键的____，证明有人刚刚复制了禁语档案。
evidence:0.hook: The chip's serial number matched Grey Crow's last known alias.
evidence:0.line: 'This *evidence* won't stay clean for long,' Ali whispered.

prefer:0.en: Grey Crow offered me two exits: the fire stairs or the ventilation shaft. I *prefer* narrow spaces when the cameras are live — less angle, less exposure. I told Ali to take the stairs and draw attention. I went into the shaft alone, heart loud in the dark.
prefer:0.cnHint: 面对两条逃跑路线，我告诉阿里走楼梯，自己则选择了更____的那条。
prefer:0.hook: Someone was already moving inside the shaft ahead of me.
prefer:0.line: 'I *prefer* the path no camera can follow,' I said.

interview:0.en: Zero sent a message: meet at the dead relay station, come alone. Ali called it a trap. I called it an *interview* — a chance to ask the questions the city had buried for years. I checked my recorder, killed the signal light, and stepped into the dark corridor.
interview:0.cnHint: 零点要求单独见面，我把这次危险的会面视为一次难得的____机会。
interview:0.hook: The relay station door was already open when I arrived.
interview:0.line: 'Think of this as an *interview*,' Zero said, smiling coldly.

middle:0.en: The blackout spread block by block. Ali and I tracked it on a cracked wall screen. The signal loss always started at the *middle* of the grid — sector seven — then fanned out like a slow breath. Someone was testing the range of a jamming device from inside that sector.
middle:0.cnHint: 停电总是从电网____的第七区开始，阿里和我意识到那里藏着信号干扰器。
middle:0.hook: Sector seven held the city's oldest — and most secret — data vault.
middle:0.line: 'The cut starts in the *middle* every single time,' Ali said.

standard:0.en: The override code Zero used was too clean. Every digit hit the *standard* format the city authority published three years ago — the one most hackers had long abandoned. No real rogue uses factory settings. This was deliberate, a message dressed as a mistake, and I was meant to read it.
standard:0.cnHint: 零点使用的代码完全符合官方____格式，这让我意识到这是一个刻意的暗示。
standard:0.hook: Someone inside the authority wanted me to follow this trail.
standard:0.line: 'No one uses *standard* codes unless they want to be found,' I said.

subject:0.en: Grey Crow slid a folder across the table without a word. Every page was redacted except one line: a *subject* heading that read SIGNAL GHOST. That was the name Zero had used in the old encrypted broadcasts. My hand steadied. The folder was not a warning. It was an invitation.
subject:0.cnHint: 文件夹里所有内容都被涂黑，只剩一个____标题，那正是零点的代号。
subject:0.hook: Below the heading, my own ID number was printed in red.
subject:0.line: 'The *subject* of this file,' Grey Crow said, 'is already in this room.'

accept:0.en: Ali told me to walk away — the data was too dangerous, the source too unclear. I listened, then shook my head. You do not *accept* a lead like this and let it go cold. The blackout would end by morning and every trace would be wiped. I had maybe two hours.
accept:0.cnHint: 阿里劝我放弃，但我无法____这条线索就这样消失，决定独自行动。
accept:0.hook: My comm unit buzzed once, then went completely silent.
accept:0.line: 'I can't *accept* that answer,' I said, and walked toward the door.

act:0.en: The lights came back for exactly four seconds — a test pulse. In that flash I saw Zero standing at the far end of the corridor, still, watching. Neither of us moved. It was an *act*, a performance of calm, and we both knew it. Then the dark returned and the corridor was empty.
act:0.cnHint: 灯光短暂亮起的瞬间，我和零点对视，双方都在____，假装镇定。
act:0.hook: When the lights returned again, only one set of footprints remained.
act:0.line: 'Nice *act*,' Zero said from somewhere in the dark.

field:0.en: The power died at 23:00. Ali spread a hand-drawn map across the floor. 'This building used to be a training *field*,' she said, tracing old boundary lines. Now it was a server vault. Someone had buried that history deep, and tonight, that someone knew we were here.
field:0.cnHint: 阿栗展开地图，指出这栋楼曾经是一个____，但现在隐藏着秘密服务器。
field:0.hook: A footstep echoed from the floor above.
field:0.line: 'This whole block was once an open *field*, before they buried everything.'

personality:0.en: The backup light flickered on, casting long shadows. Grey Crow handed me a file. 'Study Zero's *personality* before you face him,' he said quietly. The report listed cold logic, zero empathy, total patience. I closed the folder. Knowing your enemy's mind is one thing. Surviving it is another.
personality:0.cnHint: 灰鸦递给我一份档案，让我了解零点的____，为即将到来的对抗做准备。
personality:0.hook: The file's last page had been torn out.
personality:0.line: 'You cannot fight Zero without understanding his *personality* first.'

size:0.en: Ali held the signal device next to the ventilation shaft. 'The *size* of this thing matters,' she whispered, measuring the gap with her fingers. Too large and it would block the airflow, triggering an alarm. Too small and the broadcast would never reach the far tower. We had one shot.
size:0.cnHint: 阿栗测量通风口，确认设备的____是否合适，一旦出错警报就会响起。
size:0.hook: Her fingers stopped moving and her face went pale.
size:0.line: 'Check the *size* again — one centimeter wrong and we fail.'

schedule:0.en: Grey Crow pulled up a faint hologram from his wrist unit. 'Their patrol *schedule* cycles every nine minutes,' he said, eyes fixed on the blinking dots. Nine minutes to plant the tap, pull the data, and disappear. I looked at the corridor. It felt much longer than nine minutes.
schedule:0.cnHint: 灰鸦展示敌方巡逻的____，我们只有九分钟完成任务。
schedule:0.hook: One dot on the map stopped moving entirely.
schedule:0.line: 'The patrol *schedule* just changed — we have four minutes now, not nine.'

towards:0.en: The emergency lights cut out again. I moved *towards* the server room door, one hand on the cold wall, counting steps in the dark. Ali's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Stop.' I stopped. Somewhere ahead, something breathed. It was not the ventilation system.
towards:0.cnHint: 黑暗中我朝着服务器室走去，却被阿栗叫停——前方有不明动静。
towards:0.hook: The breathing grew one step closer.
towards:0.line: 'Move *towards* the blue light, slowly, and do not run.'

background:0.en: Zero's face appeared on the cracked wall screen for exactly three seconds. Grey Crow froze. 'His *background* was wiped from every public record in 2087,' he said, voice low. No school, no city, no name before that year. People without pasts are the most dangerous kind.
background:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说零点的____在2087年被彻底抹除，此人来历成谜。
background:0.hook: The screen flickered back on, showing our own faces.
background:0.line: 'A man with no *background* on record is a man we cannot predict.'

department:0.en: Ali found a dusty sign half-buried under fallen ceiling tiles: LANGUAGE CONTROL *DEPARTMENT*, LEVEL 3. She looked at me. This was the office that had banned forty-seven words in 2091. The office everyone said had closed. The lights in the corridor behind us clicked on, one by one.
department:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现了一块牌子，揭示这里曾是一个神秘的____，据说早已关闭。
department:0.hook: A chair scraped the floor behind a frosted glass door.
department:0.line: 'This *department* was closed eight years ago — so who left those fresh footprints?'

detail:0.en: Grey Crow knelt beside the terminal and studied the screen for a long moment. 'This *detail* here,' he said, pointing to a single character at the bottom of the log, 'means someone accessed this node four minutes before the blackout.' That was four minutes before we arrived. Someone had timed it perfectly.
detail:0.cnHint: 灰鸦注意到日志中的一个____，显示断电前四分钟有人访问过这里。
detail:0.hook: The timestamp matched the exact moment I left home.
detail:0.line: 'Every *detail* in this log is a clue — do not ignore the small ones.'

estimate:0.en: The power died at midnight. I stood in the dark server room, counting the seconds. Grey Crow's voice crackled through my earpiece: 'My *estimate* is twelve minutes before the backup grid kicks in. Use them well.' I had already spotted the blinking terminal in the corner.
estimate:0.cnHint: 停电后，灰鸦对剩余时间做出____，我必须在黑暗中抢先行动。
estimate:0.hook: Twelve minutes — and Zero was already in the building.
estimate:0.line: 'My *estimate* is twelve minutes before the backup grid kicks in.'

explore:0.en: Ali pressed her back against the cold wall. 'We need to *explore* every room on this floor before the lights return,' she whispered. I nodded, pulling out my signal scanner. Each closed door hid a different frequency, and one of them was broadcasting Zero's coded message.
explore:0.cnHint: 停电期间，阿栗提议____整层楼的房间，寻找零点的加密信号。
explore:0.hook: Behind the last door, the scanner screamed red.
explore:0.line: 'We need to *explore* every room on this floor before the lights return.'

fix:0.en: I could not move. The magnetic lock had snapped shut around my wrist, pinning me to the server rack. Grey Crow's calm voice arrived in my ear: 'You are in a *fix*. Breathe. The override switch is ten centimetres above your left hand.' I stretched until my fingers found cold metal.
fix:0.cnHint: 我被磁力锁困住，陷入____，灰鸦远程指引我找到解锁开关。
fix:0.hook: My fingers touched the switch — then the lights came back on.
fix:0.line: 'You are in a *fix* — but the override switch is just above your hand.'

general:0.en: The *general* layout of the building had seemed simple in the blueprints: two corridors, one stairwell, a single server room. But standing in the sudden dark, every wall felt wrong, every turn unfamiliar. Ali grabbed my sleeve and pulled me left before I walked into a hidden glass partition.
general:0.cnHint: 停电后，原本____的建筑格局变得陌生，阿栗及时拉住了我。
general:0.hook: The blueprints had not shown the room behind the glass.
general:0.line: 'The *general* layout looked simple — but something here was changed.'
